title: Claim
description: A belief held in the knowledge base, carrying a Beta posterior and its evidence.

id.description: Stable claim id — same statement keeps the same id across updates.

posterior.description: Belief as Beta(alpha,beta): mean=alpha/(alpha+beta), evidence mass=alpha+beta-2.

gate.description: Lifecycle gate. contested -> route to deliberation; unresolved -> recycle into training.

evidence.description: Evidence items folded into the posterior, kept for audit and independence-collapse.

source.description: Where this evidence came from (a node id, a debate id, an anchor set).

supports.description: true adds to alpha, false adds to beta.

ts.description: Last update time, epoch milliseconds UTC.
